Ingredients Prunus Amygdalus Dulcis Oil Simmondsia Chinensis Seed Oil Helianthus Annuus Seed Oil Ficus Carica Leaf Extract Tocopherol Key ingredients Sweet almond oil Jojoba oil Sunflower oil Fig leaf scent How to use Massage into damp skin straight after the shower and let it sink in for a minute. Warnings Contains sweet almond oil: do not use if you have a nut allergy. Oil can make the shower floor slippery, so apply it once you have stepped out. For external use only. Keep out of reach of children. Packaging and recycling Glass bottle recyclable with glass. Unscrew the pump and recycle it with plastics. Reviews (3) The fig leaf scent L
